# Oat Latte

Oat Latte uses a warm oat-and-coffee palette with a lined notebook background and muted cream tones. Long-form writing is set in a serif face and code blocks in Cascadia Code, with soft latte highlights and balanced light and dark modes that the recorded description offers for journaling and note-taking.

![Oat Latte screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/giselle-tr/Oat-Latte-Theme-Obsidian/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue

}
```
